ui_ctrl_lmb: Fast move a stack of items into another inventory
ui_ctrl_shift_lmb: Fast move half a stack of items into another inventory
ui_ctrl_c: When hovering over a weapon, copies it's serial number
ui_r_rotate: While dragging an item, rotates it
ui_fastSlotsDescription: Bound to the number keys for quick use.
ui_cannot_equip: This item can not be equipped here
ui_appearance_description: Pick a colour scheme for your inventory.
ui_prefs_desc_accessibility: Make item rarity readable without relying on colour alone.
ui_prefs_desc_behaviour: Tooltips, the hotbar and what a slot shows.
ui_prefs_desc_inventory: How items are ordered on screen. Nothing here moves an item.
ui_pref_desc_uiScale: Scales every structural size token, so the layout reflows and text stays crisp.
ui_pref_desc_backgroundDim: How much the world behind the inventory is darkened.
ui_pref_desc_reduceMotion: Removes transitions and animations across the interface.
ui_pref_desc_slotSize: Scales the item slots and grid cells without changing text or spacing.
ui_pref_desc_slotSpacing: How much room sits between slots. Zero packs them edge to edge.
ui_pref_desc_cornerStyle: How rounded slots, panels and menus are.
ui_pref_desc_textSize: Scales every label independently of the interface scale.
ui_pref_desc_itemImageSize: How much of a slot the item artwork fills.
ui_pref_desc_slotContrast: How strongly a slot stands out from the background behind it. Zero is invisible.
ui_pref_desc_panelSurface: Puts a solid panel behind each inventory. Zero is the chrome-less default.
ui_pref_desc_showSlotNoise: The fine grain over each slot.
ui_pref_desc_showDurability: Condition bars on slots. The tooltip always reports durability either way.
ui_pref_desc_showItemPlaceholder: Draws a picture icon for items with no image, instead of leaving the slot empty.
ui_pref_desc_slotBorder: How visible the edge of each slot is. Zero removes it entirely.
ui_pref_desc_figureOpacity: How strongly the mannequin between the equipment columns is drawn.
ui_pref_desc_showWeightRing: The ring beside each panel's weight readout. The numbers stay either way.
ui_pref_desc_showPanelIcon: The coloured tile at the start of each panel header.
ui_pref_desc_showSlotNumber: The 1-5 badges on the number-key slots. The keybinds still work.
ui_pref_desc_fontFamily: Swap the interface font. Useful when Inter is hard to read at small sizes.
ui_pref_desc_boldText: Thickens every label without changing its size or the layout.
ui_pref_desc_highContrast: Brightens secondary text and strengthens every outline.
ui_pref_desc_reduceTransparency: Makes menus, tooltips and badges opaque so text never sits over artwork.
ui_pref_desc_focusRing: Outlines whichever control has keyboard focus.
ui_pref_desc_showTooltips: Item detail panels on hover. Off, nothing pops up over the grid at all.
ui_pref_desc_showSearchBar: The search field above each inventory.
ui_pref_desc_showFilterChips: The category buttons above the grid. The sort control stays either way.
ui_pref_desc_showItemNotifications: The toasts that announce items arriving in or leaving your inventory.
ui_pref_desc_sortDirection: Which end of the order comes first. Empty slots stay at the back either way.
ui_pref_desc_favouritesFirst: Pin favourited items to the front of every panel. They stay starred either way.
ui_pref_desc_pageSize: How many slots are drawn before scrolling loads more. Lower is lighter.
ui_pref_desc_rarityDisplay: How item rarity is shown on a slot. The tooltip always names the tier.
ui_pref_desc_rarityPalette: Alternative rarity palettes that stay distinguishable with colour vision deficiency.
ui_pref_desc_tooltipDelay: How long to hover a slot before its tooltip appears.
ui_pref_desc_hotbarAlwaysOn: Keeps the hotbar on screen instead of hiding it after a moment.
ui_pref_desc_hotbarTimeout: How long the hotbar stays visible after you show it.
ui_pref_desc_fastSlotCount: How many of the number-key slots are drawn. The keybinds themselves never change.
ui_pref_desc_sortMode: Display order only - nothing here moves an item. Unavailable in grid layout.
ui_pref_desc_favourites: Pinned to the front of every panel. Toggle from an item’s context menu.
ui_sort_unavailable_grid: Sorting is unavailable in grid layout: an item covers several cells from its slot, so reordering the display alone would tear its footprint apart.

buy_amount: You must enter an amount to buy

cannot_carry: You can not carry that much
cannot_carry_other: Target inventory can not hold that much

item_unlicensed: You are not licensed to purchase this item
stash_lowgrade: You are not authorised to take this item
unable_stack_items: You're unable to stack these items
locker_no_value: Must contain value to open locker
